_comment: Pinned native bundle manifest. Do not edit by hand: propose changes with scripts/update_native_bundle.py and review the diff. Never point this at main/master/latest/index.
status: UNPINNED - nothing to do by hand: `python3 scripts/fetch_native_bundle.py fetch` (CI and local builds) takes the newest release of yt-dlp, cpython and ffmpeg from the bundle repository, verifies it and writes the pins over this file in the workspace. Commit the resolved file to freeze the versions. The `components` below are carried over from the previous pin (native-v2026.10.28) and are replaced when that happens.

integrity_model.zip_sha256: locally calculated from the downloaded file AND equal to the value listed in the release's SHA256SUMS.txt. Both come from the same GitHub repository/release, so this is a consistency check, NOT an independently authenticated upstream checksum.
integrity_model.inner_sha256: taken from the SHA256SUMS file inside each zip and re-calculated locally; equal in all cases.

components.name: cpython
components.notes: Runs as a process through libviddown_python.so (launcher) + libpython3.14.so; stdlib is shipped as a zip that must be extracted at runtime.
components.license_basis: license string from the bundle's BUILD_INFO.json; license files ship in the zip under licenses/

components.name: ffmpeg
components.notes: Remux-only minimal build: protocols file,pipe only (no network, no hls/dash demuxer); encoders aac,flac,pcm_s16le only (no mp3/opus encoder); libffmpeg.so and libffprobe.so are PIE executables, not JNI libraries.
